source.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B23001 (Sex by Age by Employment Status for the Population 16 Years and Over), table-based summary file https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/summary_file/2024/table-based-SF/data/5YRData/acsdt5y2024-b23001.dat, county rows (summary level 050), with Puerto Rico's municipios. Each age row pools the male and female cells; the civilian population is the pooled total minus the table's armed-forces subtotal, and 65-and-over rows (which have no armed-forces branch) carry the age total.
